يحتملون (form VIII)
# يَحْتَمِلُونَ (yaḥtamilūna) /jaħ.ta.mi.luː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِحْتَمَلَ (iḥtamala)
# يُحْتَمَلُونَ (yuḥtamalūna) /juħ.ta.ma.luː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِحْتَمَلَ (iḥtamala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
